get.summary: Whether the database has zero users yet (public)

post.summary: Bootstrap-only: creates the first Admin on an empty database, 403s otherwise

patch.summary: Self-service password change. Requires currentPassword + newPassword (min 8 chars); 401 if currentPassword is wrong.

post.summary: Create a user (Admin: any role/campaigns; Supervisor: Agent-only, campaigns within own scope)

delete.summary: Deactivate a user (Admin: anyone; Supervisor: own-scope Agents only)

patch.summary: Set a user's monthly base salary in PKR, used by payroll generation (Admin)

Admin/Supervisor-mediated forgot-password: generates a temp password (returned once, in the response), flags the account must_change_password. Admin: anyone but self; Supervisor: own-scope Agents only.

get.summary: List sales (optional ?campaignId filter). Each sale includes full utility-order fields: address/apt/city/state/zipCode, phone2, supplierName, electric/gas utility+account+rate fields, confirmationNumber, and a raw saleDateIso for client-side date-range filtering.

post.summary: Submit a sale/order (Agent). Required: campaignId, customerName, phone, amount. Accepts the full order-detail field set plus an optional saleDate.

Generate/refresh payroll for a month (Admin). Body: { month: 'YYYY-MM' }. Computes base salary + commission (approved sales amount x campaign commission_rate) per active agent; preserves existing bonus/deductions on regeneration.

patch.summary: Adjust bonus/deductions on a payroll record and recompute net salary (Admin)

get.summary: List/poll messages. ?channel= scopes to one group or DM thread (403 if you're not a member/participant); omitted, returns every message across every group you belong to plus your own DM threads.

post.summary: Send a message. For a group channel you must be a member (403 otherwise). For a DM channel (id starts with 'dm:'), also pass recipientId; the server recomputes the expected channel id and rejects a mismatch.

get.summary: List message groups. Default: only groups you belong to. ?all=true (Admin only): every group in the system, for management.

post.summary: Create a message group (Admin: any members; Supervisor: self + Agents within own campaign scope). Body: { id, name, memberIds }

patch.summary: Replace a group's membership (Admin: any; Supervisor: must be a member themselves, can only add Agents within own campaign scope)

post.summary: Wipe all business data, keeping schema intact (Admin)
